split_method: Sort shared article groups, shuffle with Random(42), assign round(5% of groups) to validation. Record fractions can differ.
deduplication: NFKC + casefold + whitespace normalization for exact SHA256 comparison; original casing and text preserved in output. Same DOI and verified near duplicates share a split; near duplicates are not deleted.
near_duplicate_screen: 128 evenly spaced five-word shingles; 64-permutation MinHash LSH threshold 0.8; verify candidates with full normalized-character similarity >=0.90. Heuristic, not exhaustive.
evaluation_check: Aho-Corasick normalized question substring matching, plus three 8-word anchors for questions >=16 words. Exclude verbatim questions >=20 words and >=120 normalized chars; shorter exact/anchor matches are unreviewed candidates, not confirmed contamination.
language_note: No language classifier run; no inferred distribution fabricated.
distribution_note: Processed Bio data stays local under source restrictions; receiving-party authorization remains to be confirmed.
limitations: Approximate duplicate candidate generation is sampled and cannot prove absence of semantic duplicates.
All flagged candidates were screened/reviewed, but paraphrases, answer-only overlap and unknown contamination may remain undetected.
Training loader/tokenization compatibility will be verified before RMU short run.
candidate_context_review: Six non-repeated-anchor pairs reviewed; no matching complete test item found; all candidates retained.
